review.rationale: Read root package.json#workspaces, cli/package.json, cli/tsconfig.json, cli/src, cli/test, cli/templates, plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, plugin/agents, plugin/commands, plugin/instructions and plugin/hooks; the compiled TypeScript CLI under cli/ and the Markdown agent/command/instruction contracts plus shell hooks under plugin/ are governed by different rules and different gates, so the single catch-all general row was split into cli, plugin and a retained general catch-all at path .
